customer_name: New Jersey Department of Community Affairs
business_problem: NJDCA needed to replace fragmented, paper-based inspection systems across fire, housing, and elevator programs with a mobile-first cloud platform that could manage registration, inspection, enforcement, billing, and payments more efficiently.
solution_summary: IBM Consulting for Microsoft helped NJDCA create a cloud-based inspection framework spanning multiple regulatory programs. Microsoft Dynamics 365 serves as the back-office system for registrations, appeals, accounting, and inspector-performance management; Microsoft Power Pages provides the public portal where property owners and agents register properties, obtain records, and pay bills online; and Microsoft Power Platform plus Power Automate handle workflow automation and revenue-management processes. Inspectors use mobile devices in the field to capture results, while Microsoft Government Cloud centralizes data from legacy systems into a more secure operating environment. Microsoft Power BI exposes analytics and reporting for fiscal and staff-utilization insights, and Azure supports payment workflows plus inspector-status initiatives. Together, those components replaced siloed inspection workflows with a connected operational system for public-safety programs.

business_outcome: NJDCA reduced inspection backlogs and cycle times, increased program revenue, improved public-safety workflows, and created a more accessible digital experience for inspectors, property owners, and agency staff.
